ev.q: In 2004, more ED visits included imaging procedures than in 1995 (43% versus 38% of visits, respectively).
National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey, 1995 and 2004.
In 2004, more ED visits included imaging procedures than in 1995 (43% versus 38% of visits, respectively).
During 1995--2004, the number of MRI or CAT scans nearly quadrupled, and the number of ultrasounds more than doubled.
